channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: One Decade of Rustls: Evolution, Benchmarks, and Future Roadmap
item.description: Rustls, a Rust TLS library, marks its decade-long progression from a grassroots project to a funded open-source initiative. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon EC2 X2idn instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Hong Kong)
item.description: Memory-optimized Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) X2idn instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Hong Kong) Region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports model caching for faster inference autoscaling and reduced cold starts
item.description: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports model caching, an inference optimization that pre-loads model weights and container images onto cluster nodes so pods start in seconds instead of minutes. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Lambda now supports direct read configuration for Amazon S3 Files
item.description: AWS Lambda now supports direct read configuration for Amazon S3 Files, letting you configure which storage your functions read from: S3 Files high-performance storage or your S3 bucket. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports multimodal embeddings for video, audio, and image content with TwelveLabs Marengo 3.0
item.description: AWS announces the availability of TwelveLabs Marengo 3.0 as an embedding model in Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, enabling customers to create multimodal embeddings for video, audio, and image content. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS HealthOmics now publishes real-time run metrics to Amazon CloudWatch
item.description: AWS HealthOmics now publishes real-time run metrics to Amazon CloudWatch, giving you visibility into workflow resource utilization as runs execute. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS DevOps Agent adds support for bidirectional Slack communication
item.description: AWS DevOps Agent now enables engineers to manage production operations across AWS, multicloud, and on-premises environments with the complete investigation lifecycle directly within Slack. (1 source: aws)

item.title: NVIDIA Personal AI Router Distributes AI Tasks across Local Compute
item.description: NVIDIA Personal AI Router (PAIR), now available in beta, lets you combine the inference capacity of multiple computers on your local network and automatically distribute AI requests among them. (1 source: infoq)
